capabilities: format loose JSON and JSON5 fragments in selections and code blocks while preserving surrounding log text
repair content to strict JSON through a preview without guessing missing values
copy JSON as JavaScript object literals with unquoted identifier keys and single-quoted strings
decode stringified JSON fields into objects or arrays by field path
extract JSON pieces from logs into separate code blocks in place
extras: A sample test note is auto-created in the vault root on first enable. Mobile behavior and minimum app versions are not yet verified. UI is Chinese and English, following Obsidian by default. No network requests, telemetry, accounts, or clipboard reads.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to format non-standard JSON or JSON embedded in logs, short of manually converting it to strict JSON first.
